body: Getting headaches most mornings and my face feels flushed a lot. Is that from the dose increase?
Being honest, I am not sure this is doing much anymore. I felt great around month two and now it feels like where I started. Thinking about stopping.
Hi Brady — the card on file was declined on this month’s membership. Can you update it when you get a minute? No rush on your therapy, nothing changes today.
Yeah that card got replaced after a fraud alert. I will put the new one in tonight.
Can I move my lab draw to a Friday? Mondays are rough with work.
Done — moved you to Friday at 9:30. You will get a confirmation.
Is there a cheaper plan? I want to keep going but this month got tight.
